title: Recurring schedule plans
description: Build and review a complete draft before publishing operational shifts. Existing schedules are never changed automatically.
forbidden: Only a manager or administrator can manage schedule plans.
name: Plan name
empty: No schedule plans for this site yet.
loadError: Schedule plans could not be loaded. Refresh and try again.
saveError: The decision could not be saved. Retry the same operation.
datesNotice: Choose up to 31 starting dates. The end date is excluded; an overnight shift may finish the following day. Every 2–4 weeks is counted from the reference Monday, which must be on or before the first date.
draftNotice: A draft does not reserve employee time or create operational shifts. Publication rechecks permissions, absences, availability and overlaps.
publishedNotice: These are the frozen published times. Later corrections or cancellations belong to the operational schedule and do not rewrite this evidence.
publishNotice_one: This decision will create {{count}} operational shift in one transaction. If any shift is invalid, none will be created.
publishNotice_other: This decision will create {{count}} operational shifts in one transaction. If any shift is invalid, none will be created.
discardNotice: Discarding retains this draft and its history. It does not cancel or change any operational shift. Enter a reason of 10–500 characters.
acknowledge: I reviewed this plan and want to publish all its shifts.
overnight: Ends on the following day (up to 24 hours)
privacyNotice: Use operational information only. Do not include health details, documents or compensation.
invalid: Review the plan name, active site, dates, reference Monday and employee rules. Select at least one day per rule and a valid shift of up to 24 hours. A regeneration reason needs 10–500 characters.
linkedShift: Linked to a published operational shift
